blocks.text: Excitatory neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron ki membrane ko Na+ ke liye zyada permeable kar ke us mein action potential paida karte hain.

blocks.text: Biogenic amines hormones ka kaam bhi karte hain. Dopamine chhorne wale neurons ka zawal Parkinson's disease ki kapkapi paida karta hai, aur serotonin chhorne wale neurons ki kam sargarmi depression la sakti hai; kai antidepressant dawayein cleft se serotonin hatne nahi deteen ta ke woh wahan der tak rahe.

Inhibitory neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron mein impulse ka imkan kam karte hain. Jab yeh judte hain to sodium ke bajaye chloride channels khulte hain; Cl- andar diffuse ho kar andar ko RMP se bhi zyada manfi kar deta hai. Yeh hyperpolarization neuron ko rokti hai.

items: GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid): CNS ka sab se aham inhibitory neurotransmitter; yeh asabi josh kam karta, pareshani, tanao aur dar ghatata, aur sukoon aur neend lata hai. Kai sukoon-awar dawayein GABA ke receptors se judne ko mazboot karti hain.
Glycine: inhibitory, khaas kar spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein.

Endorphins: dimagh ke neurons chhorte hain; yeh dard ke paigham le jane wale excitatory transmitters ka ikhraj kam kar ke dard ke signal rokte hain. Afeem aur us se bani morphine aur heroin is liye dard kam karti hain ke un ki banawat endorphins jaisi hai aur woh unhi receptors se judti hain.

blocks.title: Nerve gas
blocks.text: Neuromuscular junctions par acetylcholine skeletal muscles ko sukarta aur phir acetylcholinesterase enzyme use tor deta hai. Sarin, tabun aur soman jaisi nerve gases is enzyme ko rok deti hain, to acetylcholine jama ho kar muscles ko sukra hua rakhta hai. Agar diaphragm sukra rahe to insan saans nahi le sakta; jhatke, dauray, saans ki takleef aur maut ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab tamam biogenic amines ko excitatory kehti hai. Transmitter jagata hai ya rokta hai, yeh us receptor par munhasir hai jis se woh judta hai; dopamine, norepinephrine aur serotonin mukhtalif synapses par dono tarah kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Inhibitory neurotransmitter neuron ke fire karne ka imkan kaise kam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sodium ke bajaye chloride channels kholta hai; Cl- andar aata aur andar RMP se zyada manfi ho jata hai (hyperpolarization), to action potential ke liye bara muharrik chahiye.

items: Excitatory: acetylcholine, glutamate, biogenic amines (norepinephrine, epinephrine, dopamine, serotonin): Na+ andar.
Inhibitory: GABA, glycine, endorphins: Cl- andar, hyperpolarization. Nerve gas acetylcholinesterase ko rokti hai.
